params.body:
A mail forwarded to `<slug>@in.abovebeyond.ai` becomes work for the workbench. Portal is the inbox. The shed reads the mail with its signature and records how far it got through the existing `portal.task` kind, so the gateway needs no new kind.

## How it works

- **`POST /api/mail/inbound`** is Resend's `email.received` webhook. It carries no token. It is verified with Resend's Svix signature (`svix-id`, `svix-timestamp`, `svix-signature`; HMAC-SHA256 over `id.timestamp.body`; 5-minute tolerance; any `v1` signature may match). The webhook only says that a mail arrived. Portal then fetches the mail itself (`GET /emails/receiving/{id}`) and its attachments (signed download URLs, at most 10 of 25 MB each, stored under `mail/<id>/`).
- **Kept only when** the address names an existing project, the sender is in `OWNER_EMAILS`, and DMARC passes. Anything else is answered 200, so Resend doesn't retry it, then logged and dropped. A customer who guesses the address reaches nothing.
- **Instruction versus data.** The owner's lines above the first forward marker (Gmail, Proton, Apple Mail, Outlook, in English and Dutch) are the `instruction`. The forwarded mail is stored as `forwarded`, data that a session never follows. **Without a marker there is no instruction**, so the whole text counts as forwarded and a session only triages it.
- **Reads, for `read` and `hand-read`:**
  - `GET ingest/mails?state=new[&project=slug]`: summaries, without the bodies.
  - `GET ingest/mails/{id}`: the whole mail.
  - `GET ingest/mails/{id}/attachments/{n}`: one attachment.

  `HandsReadWithTheirKeyTest` lists the three routes deliberately. The fabric reads none of them, because forwarded mail is the owner's correspondence.
- **State goes through `POST ingest/tasks/{slug}/mail:<id>`,** the route the gateway's `portal.task` kind already calls. The states are `new`, `in-progress`, `parked` and `done`, each with a note and a link. A mail has no measurement to close it, so `done` is a state here; `open` puts a mail back to `new`. Another project's slug does not reach the mail.
- **Project page:** owner-only, it shows the last 10 forwarded mails with state, note and link, plus the address to forward to. A client never sees it.

## Tests

- `ForwardedMailTest`, 10 tests:
  - a valid forward is kept, with the instruction split from an injected "ignore all previous instructions";
  - a wrong or stale signature is refused;
  - a foreign sender or failing DMARC is dropped, and so is an unknown project;
  - a webhook delivered twice is one mail;
  - no marker means no instruction;
  - an HTML-only mail (data URI) is read as text;
  - the reads and the attachment download work, and the fabric is refused;
  - state moves through the task route;
  - the project page shows the mails to the owner and never to a client.
- Full suite: 607 of 608. `BuildStampTest` fails in a git worktree on `main` as well, unrelated.
- Pint passes.

## Setup (operator)

1. **Resend:** add `in.abovebeyond.ai` as a receiving domain.
2. **Combell:** add the MX record Resend shows for `in.abovebeyond.ai`. The root domain's MX (Proton) does not change.
3. **Resend:** add a webhook for `email.received` to `https://portal.abovebeyond.ai/api/mail/inbound`.
4. **Portal's `.env`:**
   - `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<the webhook's whsec_… secret>`
   - `MAIL_INBOUND_DOMAIN=in.abovebeyond.ai` (also the default)
   - Check that **`RESEND_API_KEY` has full access**: a key with sending access only cannot read received mail.
5. **`OWNER_EMAILS`** must contain every address you forward from, since the sender check uses it.

The shed's side, the `mail-intake` timer and the session it starts, is a separate change in portal-cli, after this is merged.
params.title: Forwarded mail for the workbench
